title: Limiting weight bounded by majority Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, with both $n$ and $k$ odd and $k\le n$. The limiting majority Fourier weight at level $k$ is at most the total Fourier weight at level $k$ of the majority function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube.
